proposal_name: FCT-001 Android Toolchain & Application Build Quality Gate
notes: Proposed check extensions for Android Foundation & First Runnable APK. Preserves approved FCT-000 baseline checks (spec-hygiene, harness-selftests) and adds Gradle wrapper integrity, Android build, unit tests, lint, APK validation, and device smoke test.

checks.description: Validates markdown link integrity, cross-spec requirement traceability, defect registry schema, and anti-pattern rules.
Executes verification harness internal self-test suite and extracts structured metrics.
Verifies gradle-wrapper.jar SHA-256 against official Gradle releases checksum and checks wrapper properties.
Executes Android Lint on the application module and enforces zero errors and zero security regressions.
Executes JVM unit tests for Android application module and extracts structured JUnit test metrics.
Compiles and packages the debug APK (:app:assembleDebug).
Verifies debug APK output existence, computes SHA-256 digest, checks package ID com.weback.robot, minSdk, and confirms zero proprietary vendor binaries.
Optional environment-gated check performing adb install and activity launch smoke test on connected emulator or authorized physical device.
